'''Aves Hunt Down and Destroy LSC''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Aves (GPN)|Aves]]
* '''Published:''' 28 November 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 HD Aves DS 2003 HuntDown.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Due to the large amounts of light side LSC and senate in my area and tournament scene i though i might modify my Hunt Down Deck and see what happens. The drainage is so powerful i think it might be able to beat some space decks (i.e. Senate or Hidden Base)

The published list has 64 cards.

== Strategy ==

This Deck is Much like any other Hunt Deck except that it shies away from space entirely. The force draining from endor is massive. With all the sites out (practically for sure) by turn 3, you can force drain for 6. if you put expand the empire on Forest Clearing, you can force drain for eight. then add 3 light sabers. A potential drain of 11 by turn 4.

Bad Feeling Have I lets me set up a duel that i am sure to win and cause massive force loss to whom ever i place out of play or turn! (drop vader, put 1 of the destiny 6 dueling interrupts under vader, play focused attack if you think he may have something up his sleeve, it adds 1 destiny to your duel total, play the other dueling interrupt, win the game).

While you are pulling for the duel you will be setting up your massive drain force on endor. The droid duo, xizor and guri, and bounty hunters will let you effectively hold the three sites, imperial barrier any beats, then drop maul w/saber and Dr Evazan to immediately chop the opposition.

Card Choices:

Dr. Evazan- operates on the two people maul hits!

Blizzard 4-lets me pull mara out if i need her at endor, and is power 9 by itself.

Many sabers- I anticipate losing vader so i pack 2 of his saber, the others are there to either beat, or if they play senate to massively force drain.

The emperor- makes mara power +2, anti senate bullet, good all around guy (plus i dont have the good one)

Xizor and Guri- awesome, power 11, forfeit 13, immune to attrition <5, If they drop a force big enough to get a battle destiny (ability < or=6)then they still only draw one, and xizor cant be hit!

Aurra sing- quietly observing, weapon levitation, aurras gun, do you get the sense of jedi hate here?

4lom- the immunity to attrition killer

snoova- the exluder from battles

Space always sucked anyways!

Tell me what you think, and what would you do ?? Also how do you rate other peoples decks? i looked for a rate button and had trouble finding it. am i just stupid or do i have to be a special member or something?
